description: Every room and rate one property has for an exact stay, live from the supplier. Each room has an all-in total, itemised fees, cancellation terms and a booking URL. `status` says whether an empty list is no rooms or a supplier outage.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after checkin.

children_ages.description: Age of each child at check-in.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to quote in. Defaults to the market's currency.

slug.description: The property slug from search_stays, e.g. 'delta-hotels-by-marriott-peterborough'.

name: price_stay
